title: Menu
subtitle: Categories, items, prices and translations for {{location}}.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.scheduleHint: Leave empty if it is served all day. E.g. breakfast 07:00–11:30.
categories.activeDescription: Inactive categories are hidden from guests and from the order screen.
categories.deleteDescription: The category must be empty. This cannot be undone.
categories.empty: Create your first category, e.g. Coffee or Main courses.

items.emptyDescription: Add the first item with its price, ingredients and translations.
items.noCategoryDescription: Items are organised in categories such as Coffee, Beer or Desserts.

item.name: Name
item.descriptionPlaceholder: Main ingredients, how it is prepared…
item.stationHint: Where the order goes: kitchen, bar…
item.priceHint: With variants, this is the “from” price.
item.costHint: Optional. Calculated from the recipe once inventory is added.
item.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. Saved straight away.
item.photoAfterSave: Save the item once to add a photo.
item.variantsHint: E.g. glass / bottle, 0.5 l / 1.5 l. Without variants the main price is used.
item.modifiersHint: Choices the waiter or guest can add, e.g. milk or sugar.
item.noModifierGroups: No modifier groups yet. Create them in the Modifiers tab.
item.popularDescription: Shows a “Popular” badge on the guest menu.
item.guestVisibleDescription: Turn off for items only staff can order.
item.activeDescription: Inactive items are hidden everywhere but kept in history.
item.deleteDescription: The item is removed from the menu. Past orders keep its name and price.

translations.hint: Leave empty to use the Albanian text.
translations.name: Name ({{lang}})

modifiers.empty: Modifier groups are choices such as “Milk” or “Doneness”.
modifiers.name: Group name
modifiers.requiredDescription: The waiter cannot send the item without choosing.
modifiers.deleteDescription: It is removed from every item that uses it.

offers.empty: Create a happy hour or a discount for set days and hours.
offers.name: Name
offers.datesHint: Leave empty for an offer with no end date.
offers.noStacking: Offers do not stack: when several apply, the lowest price wins.

setup.stationsHint: Each item is sent to its station's screen.
setup.taxRatesHint: Prices include VAT; VAT is extracted for the receipt.

import.exportDescription: Download every item as CSV (opens in Excel) to edit or keep a copy.
import.importDescription: Required columns: category, name, price. Items with the same name in the same category are updated; others are added. Variants and modifiers are not included.
import.ready: The file looks good. Nothing has changed yet.
import.applied: The menu was updated from CSV
import.errorsTitle_one: {{count}} error — nothing will change until it is fixed
import.errorsTitle_other: {{count}} errors — nothing will change until they are fixed

errors.parse: This row could not be read.
errors.unknownId: No item with id {{value}} on this menu.
errors.invalidPrice: “{{value}}” is not a price. Enter lek, e.g. 250 or 12.50.

preview.description: This is what guests see when they scan the QR code, with the prices right now.
preview.empty: Guests see nothing yet: add active, guest-visible items.
